scientific_integrity: Analytic Schur/Perron proof supplied. Standalone SymPy and rational checks supplement but do not establish an infinite-time theorem. Publication precedence beyond inspected sources and independent audit remain open.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar strongly convex quadratic, iid Bernoulli 1/p-amplified compression and classical residual error feedback; fixed positive stepsize and zero initial residual. No multidimensional, adaptive, decreasing-step or correlated-compression assertion.
title: An exact half-retention stability barrier for unbiased Bernoulli error feedback
